spot.html_text: The basic theorems of intuitionistic analysis — the bar theorem, fan theorem, and continuity theorem — are in “On the Domains of Definition of Functions” of 1927. The first two are structural theorems on spreads; the third (not to be confused with the continuity principle for choice sequences) states that every total function ⟦M⟧ is continuous and even uniformly continuous. spot.html_text: With this view in place, Brouwer sets out to reconstruct Cantorian set theory.
